name: std::basic_istream<CharT,Traits>::peek
intro: Behaves as UnformattedInputFunction. After constructing and testing the sentry object, reads the next character from the input stream without extracting it.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
If good() == true, returns the next character as obtained by rdbuf()->sgetc().

Otherwise, returns Traits::eof().

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text:
failure

goodbit

exceptions()

If an internal operation throws an exception, it is caught and badbit is set. If exceptions() is set for badbit, the exception is rethrown.
